steps.en: The offender is logged in and the session holds their ID
steps.id: Offender sudah login dan session menyimpan ID-nya

steps.en: The system finds every fine under the ID or company
steps.id: Sistem menemukan semua fine atas ID atau perusahaan

steps.en: The list shows all fines that are still unpaid
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan semua fine yang belum dibayar

steps.en: Each fine shows date, car park, vehicle and amount
steps.id: Tiap fine menampilkan tanggal, car park, kendaraan, dan nominal

steps.en: The offender ticks fines in the list to pay
steps.id: Offender mencentang fine di daftar untuk dibayar
